question: What specific yogic technique involving breath at the root of tongue and palate is prescribed?
premises: Attention is directed to the root of tongue and palate.
The breath is to be placed there.
The breath should be drawn in slowly.
inference: Therefore the prescribed technique is to place and slowly drink the breath at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Having placed the breath at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink it in.
